description: This file is a shell script used for testing git rebase --continue behavior, including setup, simulations, and validation of different rebase scenarios.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the repository state for rerere auto-update tests by resetting and checking out main branch.

methods.name: test_rerere_autoupdate
methods.description: Tests the behavior of rebase with --rerere-autoupdate and related configuration options.

methods.name: test_orig_head_helper
methods.description: Verifies that rebase sets ORIG_HEAD correctly after the operation.

methods.name: test_orig_head
methods.description: Runs tests for ORIG_HEAD correctness with different rebase invocation types.
